scenes.narration: Your thumbnail is judged at the size of a postage stamp.
scenes.caption: आपका थंबनेल डाक टिकट जितने आकार में परखा जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed video thumbnail card the size of a postage stamp resting on a pale wooden desk beside a real postage stamp for scale, soft daylight from a side window, the small text on the card unreadable.

scenes.narration: Most viewers meet your video on a crowded phone home screen.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर दर्शक आपका वीडियो भरी हुई फ़ोन स्क्रीन पर देखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a kitchen table showing a grid of six small video thumbnails packed close together, warm morning light falling across the screen.

scenes.narration: There the whole picture sits about as wide as your thumb.
scenes.caption: वहाँ पूरी तस्वीर आपके अंगूठे जितनी चौड़ी होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone propped against a mug with a single video thumbnail on screen, a short paper ruler lying beside it marking one inch against the thumbnail width, even indoor light.

scenes.narration: One quick test tells you whether your text survives that shrink.
scenes.caption: एक छोटा टेस्ट बता देगा कि टेक्स्ट छोटा होकर बचता है या नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The same thumbnail image printed twice on a dark slate surface, one large print and one stamp-sized print side by side, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: Thumbnails upload huge and then display tiny, and shrinking throws detail away.
scenes.caption: थंबनेल बड़े अपलोड होते हैं, दिखते हैं छोटे, और बारीकी खो जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A large thumbnail print flat on a table with a magnifying glass resting over its bottom corner, fine text legible under the glass and mushy outside it, bright window light.

scenes.narration: Thin letters blur away first, so words nobody reads earn nothing.
scenes.caption: पतले अक्षर पहले धुंधले होते हैं, और जो पढ़े न जाएँ वे बेकार हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A stamp-sized thumbnail print where the thin lettering has smeared into grey smudge while one bold word stays readable, lying on white paper under a strong lamp.

scenes.narration: Say your thumbnail carries six words of text across the bottom.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए आपके थंबनेल पर नीचे छह शब्द लिखे हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A thumbnail print with six words of text running along the bottom edge, spread on a desk beside a pencil, neutral daylight.

scenes.narration: Shrink it to phone size. Two words stay readable.
scenes.caption: इसे फ़ोन के आकार में छोटा करें। सिर्फ़ दो शब्द पढ़े जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen inside a video feed showing that same thumbnail shrunk small, only two of its words still legible, dim evening room light.

scenes.narration: Does this mean stripping every word? No.
scenes.caption: तो क्या हर शब्द हटा देना चाहिए? नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A plain thumbnail carrying no text at all, showing one bright orange object centred on a deep blue background, pinned to a corkboard in soft light.

scenes.narration: A cooking clip can sell on the finished dish alone.
scenes.caption: खाने का वीडियो सिर्फ़ तैयार खाने के दम पर क्लिक पा सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A food video thumbnail showing a steaming bowl of noodles with no text on it, displayed on a tablet propped on a kitchen counter, warm light.

scenes.narration: Three fat words beat six thin ones every single time.
scenes.caption: तीन मोटे शब्द छह पतले शब्दों से हमेशा बेहतर हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two thumbnail prints side by side on a desk, one carrying three very large words and one carrying six tiny words, even daylight.

scenes.narration: A thumbnail is not artwork. It is a road sign.
scenes.caption: थंबनेल कलाकारी नहीं है। यह सड़क का साइन है।
scenes.image_brief: A metal road sign carrying three short bold words standing at a junction against an open sky, bright afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Shrink your next thumbnail to one inch and squint at it.
scenes.caption: अगला थंबनेल एक इंच का करके आँखें सिकोड़कर देखें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a desk stand showing a newly made thumbnail at feed size, with a one inch paper square taped to the desk beside the screen for comparison, cool light.

scenes.caption: पहले तीन सेकंड तय करते हैं कि कौन रुकेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A stopwatch on a dark desk frozen at three seconds, lit by a single lamp, a paused video progress bar glowing on a monitor behind it.

scenes.image_brief: A monitor in a dim room filled entirely by a spinning channel logo on a blank background, the logo's glow the only light in the frame.

scenes.narration: You will know exactly what belongs in second one.
scenes.caption: आप जान जाएँगे कि पहले सेकंड में क्या होना चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A video editing timeline on a monitor with the very first second marked by a bright red flag and the rest of the track dim, cool office light.

scenes.narration: YouTube measures how long people keep watching each individual video.
scenes.caption: यूट्यूब मापता है कि लोग हर वीडियो कितनी देर देखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A retention graph on a laptop screen sloping steeply downward in its opening moments and flattening after, soft desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Videos that hold viewers early get offered to far more people.
scenes.caption: जो वीडियो शुरू में दर्शक रोकते हैं, वे ज़्यादा लोगों तक पहुँचते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A dark screen showing one video thumbnail at the centre with many smaller copies of it spreading outward in rows, even backlight.

scenes.narration: Say a ten second logo opens your five minute tutorial.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए दस सेकंड का लोगो पाँच मिनट के वीडियो से पहले चलता है।
scenes.image_brief: An editing timeline on a monitor where the first ten seconds are filled by a solid logo block and the remaining five minutes sit as an empty track, dim edit room.

scenes.narration: A third of the audience leaves before your topic even appears.
scenes.caption: आपका विषय आने से पहले ही एक तिहाई दर्शक चले जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A retention graph on a monitor dropping by a third inside the opening seconds, with a dotted vertical line marking where the topic finally begins, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Branding is not useless here. It is simply badly placed.
scenes.caption: ब्रांडिंग बेकार नहीं है। बस उसकी जगह ग़लत है।
scenes.image_brief: A channel logo printed on a card lying face down on a desk next to a hand-drawn sketch of a video end screen, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Park the logo over your closing screen, where leaving costs nothing.
scenes.caption: लोगो को आख़िरी स्क्रीन पर रखें, जहाँ जाने का नुक़सान नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A video end screen on a monitor showing a channel logo beside two suggested video boxes, dim room where the screen is the only light.

scenes.narration: Open on the problem instead. Your channel name can wait.
scenes.caption: शुरुआत समस्या से करें। चैनल का नाम इंतज़ार कर सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing the first frame of a video: one large question written across a plain background, no logo anywhere, neutral light.

scenes.narration: The video earns the intro. The intro never earns the video.
scenes.caption: वीडियो इंट्रो कमाता है। इंट्रो वीडियो नहीं कमाता।
scenes.image_brief: A balance scale on a desk with a small film reel on one pan outweighing a tiny logo badge on the other, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Delete the first five seconds of your next upload today.
scenes.caption: अगले अपलोड के पहले पाँच सेकंड आज ही काट दें।
scenes.image_brief: An editing timeline on a monitor with the first five seconds highlighted for deletion and a pair of scissors lying on the desk in front of it, screen-lit dim room.

title: 🔁 Asmita's Short ends on a thank you... the loop it just killed #shorts #youtubeshorts

description_hook: A Short does not get replayed because viewers choose to. It gets replayed because the ending hands them back to the beginning.
setting: a phone standing upright in a dark room

characters.name: Asmita
characters.description: mid twenties, long wavy hair with a blunt fringe, mustard sweatshirt, silver ring on her index finger

claims.claim: counts your viewer twice
claims.basis: illustrative way of saying a replay registers as another view, not a measured figure

claims.claim: restarts from frame one
claims.basis: arithmetic: frame one is simply the first frame of the clip

claims.claim: a fifteen second Short about folding a shirt
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: two loops read as thirty seconds

scenes.narration: A Short that loops counts your viewer twice.
scenes.caption: लूप होने वाला शॉर्ट एक ही दर्शक को दो बार गिनवाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone standing upright in a holder playing a vertical video, a bright circular arrow traced around the edge of the screen, dark room lit only by the display.

scenes.narration: Shorts play inside a feed that simply never ends.
scenes.caption: शॉर्ट्स उस फ़ीड में चलते हैं जो कभी ख़त्म नहीं होती।
scenes.image_brief: A ribbon of vertical phone screens flowing endlessly upward through a dark space, each screen showing a different vertical video, cool even light.

scenes.narration: Nobody ever presses replay. The video has to do that itself.
scenes.caption: कोई रीप्ले नहीं दबाता। वीडियो को ख़ुद दोबारा चलना पड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a rumpled bedsheet showing the frozen end card of a vertical video with an untouched replay arrow, dim bedside lamp light.

scenes.narration: You will learn how to build an ending that circles back.
scenes.caption: आप सीखेंगे कि वीडियो के अंत को शुरुआत से कैसे जोड़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A strip of film joined into a standing ring on a desk, the same vertical frame repeating around the loop, warm light from one side.

scenes.narration: A view is counted again when the Short restarts from frame one.
scenes.caption: शॉर्ट पहले फ़्रेम से फिर चलता है, तो व्यू दोबारा गिना जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen where the view counter ticks from one to two as the vertical video's opening frame reappears, dark background.

scenes.narration: More watch time on the same clip pushes it deeper into the feed.
scenes.caption: एक ही क्लिप पर ज़्यादा देखा जाना उसे फ़ीड में और आगे ले जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two vertical video panels on a dark board, one with a long bright watch time bar beneath it and one with a stub of a bar, even light.

scenes.narration: Picture a fifteen second Short about folding a shirt fast.
scenes.caption: सोचिए, पंद्रह सेकंड का शॉर्ट, जिसमें शर्ट तेज़ी से मोड़ी जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A crumpled cotton shirt on a wooden table beside a neatly folded one, a phone upright nearby showing a vertical video of the same table, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: End on the crumpled shirt again, and two loops read as thirty seconds.
scenes.caption: अंत में वही मुड़ी-तुड़ी शर्ट दिखाएँ, दो लूप तीस सेकंड बन जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone in a stand showing the closing frame of a vertical video, a crumpled shirt on the same table, identical to its opening frame, with a circular arrow drawn beside the phone.

scenes.narration: A punchline ending wants no loop. Let the joke land.
scenes.caption: जहाँ अंत में चुटकुला हो, वहाँ लूप नहीं चाहिए। उसे ठहरने दें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone upright on a desk showing the final frame of a comedy Short, an empty room with a fallen chair, warm indoor light, a large full stop painted on the wall behind.

scenes.narration: Tutorials with a clear finish do not need to circle.
scenes.caption: साफ़ अंत वाले ट्यूटोरियल को घूमकर शुरू होने की ज़रूरत नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone standing on a kitchen counter showing the last frame of a cooking Short, a finished plated dish with a tick mark on screen, warm light.

scenes.narration: Cut the spoken goodbye. Your final frame is the second hook.
scenes.caption: बोलकर विदा लेना हटाएँ। आख़िरी फ़्रेम ही दूसरा हुक है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone upright in a dark room showing a vertical video's closing frame, which is a fresh question written large across it, no end card and no wave.

scenes.narration: Rewatch your newest Short and ask whether its ending invites another.
scenes.caption: अपना नया शॉर्ट फिर देखें, क्या उसका अंत दोबारा देखने बुलाता है?
scenes.image_brief: A phone in a stand replaying a vertical video with the progress bar sliding back to its start, a notebook and pen on the desk beside it, soft morning light.

claims.claim: three of your own videos each run about four minutes long

scenes.narration: Your best video is quietly sending viewers away from your channel.

scenes.narration: A video that ends cold hands the viewer straight back to the feed.

scenes.narration: The very next thing they watch is somebody else's work.

scenes.caption: आप देखेंगे कि एक प्लेलिस्ट दर्शक को आपके साथ कैसे रोक लेती है।

scenes.caption: लंबे सेशन यूट्यूब को बताते हैं कि आपका चैनल सुझाने लायक़ है।

scenes.narration: Say three of your own videos each run about four minutes long.

scenes.image_brief: The same three thumbnails on the desk now joined by a drawn line into one chain, with twelve minutes written beside them on a notepad, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: A playlist of unrelated uploads breaks this the moment it starts.
scenes.caption: बेमेल वीडियो की प्लेलिस्ट यह फ़ायदा शुरू में ही तोड़ देती है।

scenes.narration: Nobody watching a camera review wants your holiday diary playing next.
scenes.caption: कैमरा रिव्यू देखने वाला आगे आपकी छुट्टियों की डायरी नहीं चाहता।

scenes.narration: Order a playlist like a short course, never like a shelf.

scenes.narration: Answer one question, then answer the question that answer creates.

scenes.narration: Build one playlist today from three videos that answer each other.
scenes.caption: आज तीन वीडियो से एक प्लेलिस्ट बनाएँ जो एक-दूसरे का जवाब दें।

scenes.caption: आप जान जाएँगे कि डिलीट करने से असल में क्या चला जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a delete confirmation box sitting over a video's analytics page, the steady view graph visible behind the box, dim room.

scenes.narration: YouTube recommends one video at a time, not a channel average.
scenes.caption: यूट्यूब एक-एक वीडियो सुझाता है, चैनल का औसत नहीं देखता।
scenes.image_brief: A single video thumbnail glowing at the centre of a screen while a shelf of other thumbnails from the same channel sits faded around it, even backlight.

scenes.narration: A weak video simply stops being shown to anyone. It drags nothing down.
scenes.caption: कमज़ोर वीडियो बस दिखना बंद हो जाता है। वह किसी को नहीं खींचता।
scenes.image_brief: Two thumbnails on a dark board, one with no impressions bar beneath it and one with a full bright bar, no line or wire connecting them, even light.

scenes.narration: Say one old clip still quietly collects about forty views every month.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए एक पुराना वीडियो हर महीने चालीस व्यू चुपचाप लाता है।
scenes.image_brief: An analytics list on a monitor where one old video row reports a small steady monthly view count, a magnifying glass resting over that row, soft lamp light.

scenes.narration: Delete it and that monthly traffic is gone. Nothing moves up instead.
scenes.caption: उसे हटाइए और वह ट्रैफ़िक ख़त्म। कोई दूसरा वीडियो उसकी जगह नहीं लेता।
scenes.image_brief: The same analytics list with that row now blank and labelled deleted, the monthly view line beside it dropping flat to zero, dim screen glow.

scenes.narration: Wrong information is a different case. Bad advice really does deserve deleting.
scenes.caption: ग़लत जानकारी अलग बात है। ख़राब सलाह हटानी ही चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A printed page of wrong instructions marked with a thick red cross lying on a desk in front of a monitor showing the same video, harsh lamp light.

scenes.narration: Old videos are shelves, not weights. They hold, they never pull.
scenes.caption: पुराने वीडियो शेल्फ़ हैं, बोझ नहीं। वे टिकाते हैं, खींचते नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden bookshelf holding rows of printed video thumbnail cards, the shelf level and steady, warm afternoon light through a window.

scenes.narration: Unlist your weakest old upload today instead of deleting it outright.
scenes.caption: आज अपना सबसे कमज़ोर वीडियो डिलीट नहीं, अनलिस्ट करें।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a video settings panel with visibility switched from public to unlisted while the delete button sits untouched, morning window light.

title: 🔍 Chirag's clever title wins nothing... the words viewers really search #youtube #titles

scenes.narration: Nobody searches your clever pun.
scenes.caption: आपके चतुर शब्दों के मज़े कोई सर्च नहीं करता।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a video title built around a pun, beside an empty search results page reporting no matches, dim desk light.

scenes.narration: Most of a video's life happens long after the first week ends.
scenes.caption: वीडियो की ज़्यादातर ज़िंदगी पहले हफ़्ते के बाद चलती है।
scenes.image_brief: A line graph on a screen where a video's daily views dip after the first week and then climb steadily for months, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Where does that late traffic come from? The search box.
scenes.caption: वह बाद का ट्रैफ़िक कहाँ से आता है? सर्च बॉक्स से।
scenes.image_brief: A search box on a screen with a half typed phrase in it and a dropdown of suggested queries beneath, cool even light.

scenes.narration: You will learn how to write a title real people type.
scenes.caption: आप सीखेंगे कि ऐसा टाइटल कैसे लिखें जो लोग असल में टाइप करते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A notepad on a desk with a plain video title written in block letters and a pun crossed out underneath it, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Your title is matched against the exact words a viewer typed in.
scenes.caption: आपका टाइटल उन्हीं शब्दों से मिलाया जाता है जो दर्शक ने टाइप किए।

scenes.narration: Words missing from that title cannot match any search at all.
scenes.caption: जो शब्द टाइटल में नहीं हैं, वे किसी सर्च से मेल नहीं खा सकते।
scenes.image_brief: A search results page on a monitor where every listed title shares the searched words while one unrelated title sits greyed out at the bottom, flat light.

scenes.narration: Take a title reading my honest thoughts on this new camera lens.
scenes.caption: एक टाइटल लीजिए: इस नए कैमरा लेंस पर मेरी ईमानदार राय।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a video title phrased as a vague personal thought, with a camera lens standing on the desk in front of the screen, warm light.

scenes.caption: दर्शक ने लिखा: लेंस ऑटोफ़ोकस प्रॉब्लम। एक भी शब्द मेल नहीं खाया।
scenes.image_brief: A search box on a screen holding three plain words about a lens autofocus problem, a full page of unrelated results listed below, cool light.

scenes.narration: Stuffing six keywords together reads like spam, and viewers scroll past.
scenes.caption: एक टाइटल में छह कीवर्ड ठूँसना स्पैम लगता है, लोग आगे बढ़ जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a video title crammed with six repeated keywords separated by vertical bars, the page already scrolling away from it, harsh light.

scenes.narration: Put the searchable phrase first, then your joke after the dots.
scenes.caption: पहले सर्च वाला वाक्य रखें, मज़ाक तीन बिंदुओं के बाद।
scenes.image_brief: A notepad with a title written in two halves, a plain search phrase first and a joke after three dots, a pencil resting on the page, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: A title is not a caption. It is a search query.
scenes.caption: टाइटल कैप्शन नहीं है। यह एक सर्च क्वेरी है।
scenes.image_brief: A large search box drawn on a monitor with a blinking cursor, the same words repeated below it as a video title, dim room.

scenes.narration: Type your own topic into the search box and read every suggestion.
scenes.caption: अपना विषय सर्च बॉक्स में टाइप करें और हर सुझाव पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on a desk with the YouTube search box open and a list of suggested phrases showing, a notebook and pen beside it, morning light.

title: 🗂️ Lina’s videos don’t link... the playlist habit she skipped #playlists #growth
title_alts: 🗂️ Playlists: The Growth Loop You Missed #youtube #strategy
🗂️ Link Your Videos: Boost Watch Time #growth #playlists
description_hook: Your videos are islands. Playlists make them a map. Here is how.
setting: a cozy home office with a laptop showing a youtube channel page

characters.name: Lina
characters.description: 27 years old, long blonde hair, wearing a white sweater, holding a coffee cup

scenes.narration: Your videos are islands. Playlists make them a map.
scenes.caption: आपके वीडियो द्वीप हैं। प्लेलिस्ट उन्हें नक्शा बनाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A satellite view of scattered islands in the ocean, connected by dotted lines.

scenes.narration: Without links, viewers click off after one video.
scenes.caption: लिंक के बिना, दर्शक एक वीडियो के बाद निकल जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A person walking away from a screen, leaving it behind.

scenes.narration: Sesssion time drops. The algorithm stops pushing you.
scenes.caption: Sesssion समय गिरता है। एल्गोरिदम आपको धकेलना बंद कर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A car running out of fuel, engine sputtering and stopping.

scenes.narration: We will show you how to chain your content.
scenes.caption: हम आपको अपने कंटेंट को जोड़ने का तरीका दिखाएँगे।
scenes.image_brief: A chain link connecting two separate gears, starting to turn.

scenes.narration: Group videos by topic, not by date. Logic wins.
scenes.caption: वीडियो को तारीख़ के अनुसार, विषय के अनुसार समूहीकृत करें। तर्क जीतता है।
scenes.image_brief: Files being sorted into labeled folders, instead of a single pile.

scenes.narration: The end screen loads the next video in the same list.
scenes.caption: End स्क्रीन उसी सूची में अगला वीडियो लोड करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a 'Up Next' box pointing to a related video thumbnail.

scenes.narration: Lina grouped her tutorials. Watch time rose 20%.
scenes.caption: लिना ने अपने ट्यूटोरियल समूहीकृत किए। Watch समय 20% बढ़ा।
scenes.image_brief: A clock face with the hands moving faster, labeled '20%'.

scenes.narration: One viewer watched four videos in a single sitting.
scenes.caption: एक दर्शक ने एक बैठक में चार वीडियो देखे।
scenes.image_brief: A stack of four video icons playing simultaneously, or in sequence.

scenes.narration: Do not mix beginner and advanced topics in one list.
scenes.caption: एक सूची में शुरुआती और उन्नत विषय न मिलाएं।
scenes.image_brief: A ladder with rungs labeled 'Beginner' at the bottom and 'Pro' at the top.

scenes.narration: Confusing order breaks the flow. Keep the difficulty steady.
scenes.caption: भ्रमित करने वाला क्रम फ्लो तोड़ता है। कठिनाई स्थिर रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A smooth, upward sloping line, without sudden jumps or dips.

scenes.narration: The algorithm loves linear paths. Give it one.
scenes.caption: एल्गोरिदम रैखिक पथों को प्यार करता है। उसे एक दें।
scenes.image_brief: A straight, glowing road leading into the distance, clearly marked.

scenes.narration: Pick your top five videos. Put them in one list.
scenes.caption: अपने टॉप पाँच वीडियो चुनें। इन्हें एक सूची में रखें।
scenes.image_brief: A hand dragging five icons into a single, labeled folder.

title: 🎬 Arjun’s intro slides for ten seconds... the retention killer #youtube #retention
title_alts: 🎬 Stop the Intro: Fix Your Retention Graph #youtube #editing
🎬 The 10-Second Rule: Keep Viewers Watching #growth #video
description_hook: Your intro is too long. Watch how your retention graph plummets.
setting: a dark editing suite with multiple monitors showing timelines

characters.name: Arjun
characters.description: 28 years old, short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt, focused expression

scenes.narration: Ten seconds of silence. The viewer is already gone.
scenes.caption: दस सेकंड की खामोशी। दर्शक पहले से चले गए।
scenes.image_brief: A digital clock ticking rapidly, with a progress bar filled to zero.

scenes.narration: YouTube measures engagement by how fast you speak.
scenes.caption: YouTube बात करने की गति से engagement मापता है।
scenes.image_brief: A waveform audio visualization starting slowly, then becoming jagged and fast.

scenes.narration: Slow starts signal boredom. The algorithm punishes you for it.
scenes.caption: धीमा शुरुआत बोरियत बताती है। एल्गोरिदम आपको सजाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A sad face emoji next to a downward trending arrow on a chart.

scenes.narration: We will cut the fluff in the next minute.
scenes.caption: अगले मिनट में हम अनावश्यक बातों को काट देंगे।
scenes.image_brief: Scissors cutting through a thick, tangled red tape.

scenes.narration: The first frame sets the energy. Start mid-action.
scenes.caption: पहला फ़्रेम ऊर्जा तय करता है। कार्रवाई के बीच शुरू करें।
scenes.image_brief: A person jumping into a pool, captured right at the splash moment.

scenes.narration: No logo. No name. Just the promise of the video.
scenes.caption: न लॉगो, न नाम। सिर्फ़ वीडियो का वादा।
scenes.image_brief: A bold text overlay appearing instantly on a moving background image.

scenes.narration: Arjun removed his logo. Retention rose by twelve percent.
scenes.caption: अर्जुन ने अपना लॉगो हटाया। Retention बारह प्रतिशत बढ़ी।
scenes.image_brief: A before-and-after comparison of two retention graphs, the right one higher.

scenes.narration: He started with the question, not the greeting.
scenes.caption: उन्होंने शंका से शुरू किया, नमस्कार नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A microphone with a question mark symbol floating above it.

scenes.narration: Do not rush the setup. Context still needs three seconds.
scenes.caption: सेटअप को जल्दबाज़ी में न करें। संदर्भ को तीन सेकंड चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A timer showing exactly three seconds with a green checkmark.

scenes.narration: Rushing too fast confuses the viewer. Balance is key.
scenes.caption: बहुत तेज़ होना दर्शकों को भ्रमित करता है। संतुलन ज़रूरी है।
scenes.image_brief: A balance scale with a clock on one side and a brain on the other.

scenes.narration: Your hook is your handshake. Make it firm.
scenes.caption: आपका हुक आपका हाथ मिलाना है। इसे मज़बूत बनाएं।
scenes.image_brief: Two hands shaking firmly in the center of the frame, brightly lit.

scenes.narration: Watch your graph. Where does it drop first?
scenes.caption: अपना ग्राफ़ देखें। यह सबसे पहले कहाँ गिरता है?
scenes.image_brief: A finger tracing a line on a retention chart, stopping at a dip.

title: 📉 Priya's video sits at 3% CTR... the thumbnail fix you missed #youtube #growth
title_alts: 📉 The CTR Killer: Why Your Thumbs Fail #youtube #thumbnails

description_hook: Your click-through rate is dying. Learn the one data point that reveals why.
setting: a clean desk with a laptop showing youtube studio analytics

characters.name: Priya
characters.description: 25 years old, brown hair in a ponytail, casual hoodie, wearing round glasses

scenes.narration: Three percent CTR. That is a death sentence for growth.
scenes.caption: तीन प्रतिशत CTR। वृद्धि के लिए मृत्युदंड।
scenes.image_brief: A glowing laptop screen showing a red line graph dropping sharply, close up.

scenes.narration: Viewers decide in one second. Your thumbnail is their first verdict.
scenes.caption: दर्शक एक सेकंड में choice करते हैं। थंबनेल पहला फैसला है।
scenes.image_brief: A blurred background with a single sharp, high-contrast thumbnail image floating in the center.

scenes.narration: If the face is blurry, the algorithm buries you instantly.
scenes.caption: अस्पष्ट चेहरा? एल्गोरिदम आपको तुरंत दबा देगा।
scenes.image_brief: A slightly out-of-focus human face next to a crisp, sharp object to show contrast.

scenes.narration: By the end, you will spot the visual flaw.
scenes.caption: अंत तक, आप दृश्य कमजोरी को देख लेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A checklist appearing on a digital screen, items checking off one by one.

scenes.narration: The eye seeks contrast. Low contrast fades into the feed.
scenes.caption: आंखें कंट्रास्ट की खोज में होती हैं। कम कंट्रास्ट अदृश्य हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A split screen comparing a dull, washed-out image against a vibrant, high-contrast version.

scenes.narration: Bold colors pop. The brain registers them before the text.
scenes.caption: तेज़ रंग उभरते हैं। दिमाग टेक्स्ट से पहले उन्हें पकड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: Bright yellow and red shapes emerging from a dark, muted background.

scenes.narration: Priya switched to a bright yellow background for her face.
scenes.caption: प्रिया ने अपने चेहरे के पीछे चमकता हुआ पीला रंग चुना।
scenes.image_brief: A person with a happy expression against a solid, bright yellow background.

scenes.narration: Her CTR jumped to six percent within two days.
scenes.caption: दो दिनों में उनका CTR छह प्रतिशत तक पहुँचा।
scenes.image_brief: A graph line spiking upward sharply, with a small calendar showing '2 days'.

scenes.narration: But bright colors only work if the subject is clear.
scenes.caption: लेकिन तेज़ रंग तभी काम करते हैं जब विषय साफ़ हो।
scenes.image_brief: A colorful, chaotic scene where the main object is hard to identify.

scenes.narration: Clutter kills the pop. Simplicity is the true secret weapon.
scenes.caption: गड़बड़ी चमक को मार देती है। सादगी असली शक्ति है।
scenes.image_brief: A minimalist composition with one large subject and lots of empty space.

scenes.narration: Your content matters, but the click comes first.
scenes.caption: आपका कंटेंट मायने रखता है, लेकिन क्लिक पहले आता है।
scenes.image_brief: A mouse cursor hovering over a large, inviting play button.

scenes.narration: Check your last three thumbnails. Fix the brightest one.
scenes.caption: अपने पिछले तीन थंबनेल देखें। सबसे चमकदार को ठीक करें।
scenes.image_brief: A hand pointing at a row of three different thumbnail images on a screen.

title: 🔍 Kabir’s title says 'Amazing'... the words viewers actually search #titles #seo
title_alts: 🔍 Stop Using 'Amazing': Real SEO Title Words #youtube #seo
🔍 The Search Trap: Fix Your YouTube Titles #growth #seo
description_hook: Stop using vague words. Learn the specific terms that drive search traffic.
setting: a minimal desk with a laptop and a notebook filled with handwritten notes

characters.name: Kabir
characters.description: 30 years old, beard, wearing a blue button-down shirt, holding a pen

scenes.narration: 'Amazing' is a stop word. It carries zero search weight.
scenes.caption: 'अमैज़िंग' एक stop word है। इसका कोई खोज वज़न नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A word 'AMAZING' with a red strikethrough line across it, bold and clear.

scenes.narration: Search engines cannot understand adjectives. They need nouns.
scenes.caption: खोज इंजन विशेषण समझते नहीं हैं। उन्हें संज्ञा चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A magnifying glass looking over a document, ignoring letters and focusing on shapes.

scenes.narration: If they cannot index it, they will never show it.
scenes.caption: यदि वे इसे index नहीं कर सकते, तो कभी दिखाएँगे नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A document falling off a shelf into a dark void, disappearing.

scenes.narration: You will learn to write indexable titles in seconds.
scenes.caption: आप सेकंडों में indexable टाइटल लिखना सीख जाएँगे।
scenes.image_brief: A keyboard with keys glowing, typing out a clear, simple sentence.

scenes.narration: Use the question people type. Mirror their phrasing exactly.
scenes.caption: उस प्रश्न का उपयोग करें जो लोग टाइप करते हैं। उनका शब्दोचितन पूरा मिलाएं।
scenes.image_brief: A search bar with a user typing a question, and a mirror reflection showing the same.

scenes.narration: Specificity beats flair every single time. Always.
scenes.caption: विशिष्टता हर बार फ्लैयर को हराती है। हमेशा।
scenes.image_brief: A scale weighing a diamond (specificity) easily outweighing a feather (flair).

scenes.narration: Kabir changed 'Cool Tip' to 'Fix Windows Update Error'.
scenes.caption: कबीर ने 'कूल टिप' को 'फिक्स विंडोज़ अपडेट एरर' में बदला।
scenes.image_brief: A document changing text from vague words to a specific technical phrase.

scenes.narration: Impressions tripled. Views doubled within a week.
scenes.caption: Impressions तीन गुना हो गए। एक सप्ताह में views डबल हो गए।
scenes.image_brief: A bar chart with bars growing rapidly in height, labeled 'Impressions'.

scenes.narration: Do not stuff keywords. It looks robotic and unreadable.
scenes.caption: Keywords stuff न करें। यह रोबोटिक और अपठनीय लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A robotic head with question marks popping out of its ears, looking confused.

scenes.narration: Read it aloud. If it sounds like a robot, rewrite.
scenes.caption: उछलकर पढ़ें। यदि यह रोबोट जैसा लगता है, फिर से लिखें।
